extracted_factors.Label: Devolution of Forest Management
extracted_factors.Description: The transfer of forest management authority to local communities aimed at improving sustainability and reducing deforestation.

extracted_factors.Label: Economic Preferences
extracted_factors.Description: Stakeholder interest in forest use driven by economic benefits influences forest cover outcomes.

extracted_factors.Label: Institutional Robustness
extracted_factors.Description: Strength of governance systems, including property rights enforcement and conflict resolution, impacting forest management effectiveness.

extracted_factors.Label: Deforestation
extracted_factors.Description: The extent of forest cover loss as a result of management practices and economic activities in the area.
